svg.title: Security research casebook: $2,000 in awarded bounties
svg.desc: Blinkit: $1,500 awarded for an Android application arbitrary file read. Kraken: $500 awarded for a desktop application security misconfiguration, resolved. Other research: Google acknowledged and reported; Meta reported; IRCTC acknowledged by CERT-In; NorthCap University authorised testing; Meesho identified. Organisation marks identify research records and do not imply endorsement.
